title: LCH-01 launch gate registry (repository-only template)
description: Repository-only enumeration of the 17 canonical launch gates from PLAN.md section 8. Every gate is PENDING, the go/no-go decision is PENDING with no signatory, date, or evidence, and no approval is recorded. This fixture is a fillable template foundation — it does not claim launch completion. It is a separate artifact and does not modify or duplicate config/current-state.json, which remains the authoritative source of truth (0/17 gates complete, 0/14 phases accepted, production pre-production, dataStage synthetic-only, scope browser-only).

authority.note: current-state remains the authoritative manifest; this registry never overrides it. Gate count and phase count in current-state stay 0/17 and 0/14.

gates.title: PII Cleanliness
gates.definition: Zero real PII in docs, demo data, logs, or public storage; secret scan clean; sanitized demo artifacts (PLAN.md section 8).

gates.title: Authentication and Authorization
gates.definition: Every privileged or data-changing endpoint enforces authentication and authorization; intentionally public endpoints are documented, narrowly scoped, abuse-tested, and rate-limited (PLAN.md section 8).

gates.title: Credential Rotation and Secret Management
gates.definition: Existing local keys rotated before first commit; no service-role or provider secret in source, image, client bundle, logs, or CI; production secrets use an approved manager or runtime identity (PLAN.md section 8).

gates.title: Upload Security
gates.definition: No unauthenticated file upload endpoints; recording upload is authenticated, size-limited, and content-validated (PLAN.md section 8).

gates.title: No Sole Automated Rejection
gates.definition: No automated rejection without human review and action; candidate status change to rejected requires human action, enforced in code (PLAN.md section 8).

gates.title: Recording Consent
gates.definition: Recording consent is mandatory before room join; consent record is stored with timestamp (PLAN.md section 8).

gates.title: Production Database Migration
gates.definition: Migration to the company-controlled production database project complete under the production email; tenancy-appropriate policy tests pass; storage verified private; final reconciliation signed; rollback available; region and backup evidence satisfy owner decisions (PLAN.md section 8).

gates.title: Backup and Restore
gates.definition: Database and recording restore drills complete successfully; approved recovery objectives measured, including backup-expiry behavior for deletion requests (PLAN.md section 8).

gates.title: Load, Spike, and Soak
gates.definition: Load, spike, and soak tests pass at approved launch concurrency and safety headroom for the approved duration; latency, error, saturation, backlog, and cost remain within the error budget (PLAN.md section 8).

gates.title: Observability
gates.definition: Logs, metrics, and traces flowing to the observability platform; alerts configured and tested; on-call rotation active (PLAN.md section 8).

gates.title: CI/CD Integrity
gates.definition: CI pipeline green on main; branch protection enforced; deployment approval gate active (PLAN.md section 8).

gates.title: End-to-End Voice
gates.definition: Automated and human-reviewed end-to-end voice suites pass across the approved browser, device, network, and accent matrix; transcript ordering, consent, recording, and asynchronous scorecard validated (PLAN.md section 8).

gates.title: Reliability
gates.definition: Lifecycle, stable transcript identifiers and ordering, durable post-session jobs, retries, dead-letter handling, idempotency, graceful shutdown, and reconciliation pass failure-injection tests (PLAN.md section 8).

gates.title: Security Posture
gates.definition: Threat model and security test suite have no unaccepted critical or high finding; dependency, SAST, DAST, secret, upload, policy, and authorization tests pass; any exception has a named owner, compensating control, and expiry (PLAN.md section 8).

gates.title: Fairness
gates.definition: Human-oversight enforcement, calibration, and legally approved fairness and accommodation tests meet launch thresholds; unresolved material disparity blocks launch (PLAN.md section 8).

gates.title: Legal Sign-Off
gates.definition: Legal approval of privacy notice and terms, AI and recording consent, data-protection posture, retention and legal holds, data-subject process, vendor agreements and subprocessors, and residency decisions (PLAN.md section 8).

gates.title: Data Lifecycle
gates.definition: Retention, legal-hold, deletion and backup aging, and data-subject export, correction, and deletion are implemented and tested (PLAN.md section 8).

evidence.note: Repository-only fixture; no authentic external evidence exists and none is claimed.
